articles.summary: Workers in the hospitality industry feel the least prepared for retirement compared to their peers in other sectors, according to a new study by Human Interest.
articles.title: Hospitality Workers Least Prepared for Retirement, New Industry Ranking Reveals

articles.summary: Human Interest has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list. The award highlights venture- and private-equity-backed startups that drive social and environmental change through innovative business models.
articles.title: Human Interest Named to Fortune’s Impact 20 List of World-Changing Startups
